title: StartTaskInput
description: start_task arguments. Starts the CREATED task once. `confirm` pins what create_task proposed.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen key. Same key and same input returns the first result; same key and different input is idempotency_conflict.

confirm.description: Values from create_task's proposal. A start whose fresh route disagrees is refused with route_changed and starts nothing.
